one_line: A Saka Kshaharata ruler of western India whose silver coins became the battlefield of his clash with Gautamiputra Satakarni.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but strong build, about average height with a warrior’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones and a straight nose, medium-tan complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, slightly sharp brows over large, intense anime-style eyes; default expression is calm, calculating focus with a trace of guarded pride.
appearance.hair: Thick dark brown hair cut to about the nape of the neck, brushed back from the forehead and held by a narrow silver circlet; circlet has a simple central roundel and no towering crest, keeping a modest, governor-like look.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Indo-Scythian–Deccan outfit: a long-sleeved, mid-thigh-length white cotton tunic (kurta-like) with a subtle narrow red border at cuffs and hem, worn over close-fitting brownish-red trousers gathered at the ankles; around his torso a fitted, sleeveless pale leather jerkin reinforced with horizontal stitched bands for light armor; over the left shoulder a muted indigo cotton sash draped diagonally across the chest and knotted at the right hip, its border edged with a fine repeating wave pattern in dull gold; on his feet, soft brown leather boots reaching mid-calf with simple lacing; at his waist, a dark maroon cloth belt over a plain leather girdle, from which hangs a small coin-pouch and a sheathed dagger; jewellery kept restrained but elite—small silver stud earrings, a single medium-width silver bangle on his right wrist, and a simple bead necklace of alternating dark stone and silver beads.
appearance.signature: A single, slightly worn silver coin of Nahapana held between his fingers or dangling from a narrow leather thong at his belt, its original legend still visible but partly overstruck, symbolising his contested authority and the Jogalthambi hoard.

ref_desc: Nahapana is a lean, tan, oval-faced Saka ruler with dark brown hair brushed back under a narrow silver circlet, wearing a white long-sleeved tunic, brownish-red trousers, pale leather jerkin, indigo sash, maroon belt and boots, and always carrying a slightly worn silver coin of his own issue.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nahapana, a late-30s lean Saka ruler from the western Deccan: he has a medium-tan oval face with high cheekbones, a neat short beard and moustache, sharp brows and large intense eyes, and thick dark brown hair brushed back to the nape of his neck, held by a narrow silver circlet with a simple central roundel; his main outfit is a long-sleeved white cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh with a fine narrow red border at the cuffs and hem, over close-fitting brownish-red trousers gathered at the ankles, and a fitted sleeveless pale leather jerkin reinforced with horizontal stitched bands worn over the tunic; a muted indigo cotton sash runs from his left shoulder diagonally across his chest and is knotted at the right hip, its edge decorated with a subtle dull-gold wave pattern, and his waist is cinched by a dark maroon cloth belt over a plain leather girdle holding a small coin-pouch and dagger sheath; he wears soft brown leather boots up to mid-calf with simple lacing, plus restrained elite jewellery—small silver stud earrings, one medium-width silver bangle on his right wrist, and a bead necklace of alternating dark stone and silver beads; his constant prop is a slightly worn silver coin of Nahapana, shown either held lightly between his fingers or hanging from a narrow leather thong at his belt, with the overstruck surface hinted at; keep the palette dominated by white, indigo, brownish-red, maroon and silver, and present him from multiple angles with consistent face, hair, costume and coin so he can be redrawn identically in many panels.
